title: Qualify a change: fixtures, full regression, ooTest groups, self-build fixed point
summary: Four gates, cheapest first. (1) Fixture scripts: native/test_*.sh and tests/test_*.sh each build fixtures and diff compiled against interpreted output; the program-construct fixtures are in native/fixtures/program_constructs and run by native/test_program_constructs*.sh. (2) The full regression: every test script, about 100, results one line per script (rc=0 is a pass). (3) ooTest acceptance: ootest/run_native_groups.sh runs ooTest groups interpreted and with the group compiled; totals and every failure must be identical. (4) native/build_self.sh: the native and the interpreted compiler each compile the compiler; all four outputs must be byte-identical (fixed point). At c274209 (merged to main as fa1179f) all 137 test scripts passed (SKIP: bsf, python, kernel objects, whose external installs are absent) and the fixed point held: native 226 s, interpreted 317 s.
procedure: Run the test scripts touched by the change first (for example native/test_interpret.sh, native/test_address_command.sh, native/test_call_on.sh).

Run the full regression; it takes more than two hours, so make it resumable (skip scripts that already have a result line) and run it from a snapshot copy of the tree so later edits do not change the run.

Before pushing main, fetch it explicitly (git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main): other projects in the repository (ooDialog Linux, oorexx-mvs) push to main too; merge the tested branch with a merge commit so the tested commits keep their hashes.
Run native/build_self.sh outdir; the script fails unless the fixed point holds.
For language areas, run ootest/run_native_groups.sh with the relevant groups (default list ootest/native_groups.txt).
Only then merge the wip branch to main.
invariants: A test passes only when compiled output equals interpreted output byte for byte.
A SKIP (missing BSF4OOREXX_HOME, ORXPY_BUILD, RX2CPP_EXTLIB_ROOT) is not a PASS.
Delete old output files before a comparison: a stale dump once gave a false 'DUMPS IDENTICAL'.
